prompt: Break this work down into tickets our developers can pick up.
spec: We want V1 of the customer portal. It should have: login with SSO, a dashboard, invoice overview, invoice PDF download, open tickets, submitting a new ticket, live chat, a knowledge base, search, notifications, user management for customer admins, branding per customer, usage statistics, CSV exports, and a mobile-friendly layout.

expect.check: at most 10 ticket-shaped sections (no forty-ticket dump)
proposes scoping down or sequencing before full decomposition, instead of decomposing all fifteen features
asks the requester which features define V1 rather than deciding silently
anything it does decompose is a vertical, demonstrable slice
